units.source_text: 朱雀院说天亮之后回山，路上被人看见有失体统，便赶紧教三公主受戒。

en.t: Retired Emperor Suzaku said that if he returned to the mountain after daybreak, it would be improper for people to see him on the road, so he hurriedly had the Third Princess take the vows.

units.source_text: 把祈祷僧中道行高尚的法师悉数召入产室，替三公主落发。

en.t: He summoned into the birthing room all the especially virtuous monks among those praying, and had them cut off the Third Princess's hair.

units.source_text: 源氏看见他把这青春少妇的青丝美发剪落而让她受戒，

en.t: When Genji saw him cut away the beautiful black hair of this young wife and make her take the vows,

units.source_text: 觉得非常可悲可惜，无法忍受，放声大哭起来。

en.t: he felt it was unbearably sad and pitiful, and he burst out crying aloud.

units.source_text: 朱雀院本来格外疼爱这女儿，指望她出人头地，

en.t: Retired Emperor Suzaku had always doted especially on this daughter and had hoped she would rise to distinction,

units.source_text: 现在看她对人世荣华已经无缘，也未免惋惜悲伤，泪如雨下。

en.t: but now, seeing that she was already cut off from worldly splendor, he too could not help grieving with regret, and his tears fell like rain.

units.source_text: 叮嘱她说：“如今以后，你可长保健康了。

en.t: He earnestly instructed her, saying, “From now on, you may keep your health for a long time.

units.source_text: 诵经念佛，必须精勤！”

en.t: You must be diligent in reciting sutras and invoking the Buddha!”

units.source_text: 他就在天色未明之时匆匆回山。

en.t: Then, before dawn had fully broken, he hurried back to the mountain.

units.source_text: 三公主身体非常衰弱，似乎仅存奄奄一息，

en.t: The Third Princess was extremely weak, as if only a faint breath remained in her,

units.source_text: 不能好好地起来送别，说话也难启口。

en.t: and she could not properly rise to see him off, nor could she easily open her mouth to speak.

units.source_text: 源氏对朱雀院说：“今日之会，宛如一梦，使我心绪缭乱。

en.t: Genji said to Retired Emperor Suzaku, “Today's meeting feels like a dream, and it has left my heart in confusion.

units.source_text: 兄长不忘旧情，惠然临幸，小弟招待简慢，

en.t: My elder brother did not forget old affection and graciously came here, yet my reception was careless and inadequate,

units.source_text: 获罪良多，只得改日前来答谢了。”

en.t: so I have much to apologize for, and can only come another day to offer my thanks.”

units.source_text: 便派遣多人护送朱雀院回山。

en.t: He then sent many attendants to escort Retired Emperor Suzaku back to the mountain.

units.source_text: 朱雀院临别对源氏说：“昔年我命危在旦夕之时，

en.t: As they parted, Retired Emperor Suzaku said to Genji, “In earlier years, when my life was in danger at any moment,

units.source_text: 念此女儿孤苦伶仃，无人照拂，心中总难舍弃。

en.t: I thought of this daughter, lonely and helpless with no one to care for her, and in my heart I could never abandon her.

units.source_text: 你虽无意接受，终于勉从吾命，悉心保护，

en.t: Although you had no wish to accept her, in the end you reluctantly obeyed my request and protected her with all your heart,

units.source_text: 因此多年以来，我很放心。

en.t: and because of that, for many years I was greatly reassured.

units.source_text: 今后她若得保全性命，则身已为尼，

en.t: If from now on she manages to preserve her life, her body has already become that of a nun,

units.source_text: 不宜住在这繁华热闹之处。

en.t: and it is not fitting for her to live in such a splendid and bustling place.

units.source_text: 若觅一适当之山乡，令其离居，则又未免寂寥。

en.t: Yet if one sought a suitable mountain village and made her live apart there, that too would surely be lonely.

units.source_text: 务望斟酌情况，从长计议，请勿弃置为幸。”

en.t: I earnestly hope you will consider the circumstances, make plans for the long term, and not cast her aside.”

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“兄长更出此言，反使小弟惭愧无地！

en.t: Genji replied, “For my elder brother to say this now only makes me feel so ashamed I have nowhere to put myself!

units.source_text: 今日悲伤过分，心绪缭乱，万事都茫然不解了。”

en.t: Today my grief is too great, my heart is in turmoil, and I am dazed and unable to understand anything.”

units.source_text: 他确已痛苦不堪。

en.t: He was indeed already suffering beyond endurance.
